import json, subprocess
def run(doc):
    p = subprocess.run(['python3','submission/main.py'], input=json.dumps(doc).encode(), stdout=subprocess.PIPE)
    return json.loads(p.stdout)
cfg = {"slots":1,"window":1,"idle_timeout":1000,"len_quantum":1,"gap_quantum":1,
       "rate_num":1,"rate_den":1,"bucket_capacity":10,"initial_tokens":10,
       "pending_capacity":512,"lanes":2,"service":[5,4],"fallback":0,
       "time_edges":[0],"count_edges":[0],"probability":[[65536]]}
mdl = {"classes":2,"embedding_dim":1,
       "length_embedding":[[i] for i in range(16)],"gap_embedding":[[0] for _ in range(16)],
       "kernel":1,"conv_weights":[[[1,0]]],"conv_bias":[0],"conv_shift":[0],
       "dense_weights":[[0],[1]],"dense_bias":[1,0]}
pkts=[{"time":0,"connection":"a","length":0,"draw":0},
      {"time":1,"connection":"a","length":0,"draw":0},
      {"time":2,"connection":"a","length":5,"draw":0},
      {"time":6,"connection":"a","length":5,"draw":0}]
doc={"version":1,"config":cfg,"model":mdl,"connections":[{"id":"a","slot":0,"label":1,"split":"dev"}],"packets":pkts}
out=run(doc)
for j in out["jobs"]: print(j["id"], "done", j["done"], "pred", j["prediction"], j["status"])
print("forwards", [p["forward"] for p in out["packets"]])
b=run(doc); b=json.loads(subprocess.run(['python3','tmp/ref.py'],input=json.dumps(doc).encode(),stdout=subprocess.PIPE).stdout)
print("ref agrees:", out==b)
PYEOF
